description:
Apply the transaction benchmark’s recorded fsync-residual decision behind the existing preparation and pre-commit barriers, or record that no deduplication is needed when the criteria show no avoidable cost.

## Background

The benchmark owns measurement and evidence; this dependent task owns the narrowly bounded production follow-up. Directory fsyncs remain load-bearing and the transaction protocol remains unchanged.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Re-runs `scripts/benchmark-transaction.sh` and applies deduplication only in `crates/jit/src/storage/file_transaction.rs` where the artifact shows avoidable directory-fsync cost behind existing preparation or pre-commit barriers.
- [hard] REQ-02: Updates `dev/benchmarks/test-suite-performance-4b7c06d0.json` with the applied decision, criteria, and rerun evidence, including a no-change decision when no deduplication is needed.
- [hard] REQ-03: Preserves atomic publication, durability barriers, both root shapes, and recovery semantics.
title: Apply the benchmark-driven fsync decision
